title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Tuesday, 27 October 2026
description: Anthropic formally files for a Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT, South Australia's premier refers a $15 billion road project to ICAC over bikie infiltration fears, a Queensland fencing project nearly triples endangered yakka skink numbers, and the Gold Coast heads for its wettest October in six years. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
